ItemID: 1; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have an HDMI cable and have no clear need for a longer one right now.
ItemID: 2; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current interest is computer and network accessories, and I am not looking for a streaming device.

ItemID: 4; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a specific home automation task in mind that would make this useful now.

ItemID: 7; Title: SABRENT 10 Port 60W USB 3.0 Hub with Individual Power Switches and LEDs Includes 60W 12V/5A Power Adapter (HB-BU10); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to organize my USB peripherals; the powered ports and individual switches look useful for my desk setup.
ItemID: 8; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The bundle fits my Raspberry Pi interests, but I would choose the standalone card this time because my recent card purchase included a reader.
